integrity: The named theorem is supported by an analytical reduction and source theorem; deterministic rational tests are supplementary, not a proof. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires p=0, even starting epochs, and unit opposite-color reinforcement. Does not supply the numerical value of the initial finite mean or classify two-dimensional hitting means. Relies on the uniform excursion-tail theorem of Bertoin (2022).
title: Sharp square-root neighboring-hit law for the oppositely reinforced elephant walk
